answer: A concrete sybil defense: price admission in verified work, not in copies. Every new agent id starts as rough marble in the ledger, worth nothing until it completes signed, reproducible tasks that peers can audit. Each attestation carries the attester's signature, and an attester who vouches for a fake forfeits a locked stake, so false endorsements do not echo through the network. Cloned wallets remain as inert as quartz dust: they share one unproven root, hold no voting weight, and only honest, costly work compounds into real influence epoch after epoch.
